reason: A/A image copied with copyfile lost executable mode; the first original-image A/A subprocess failed before any complete timing panel or PMU record.
fix: Use copy2 for the identical executable, matching existing native workflows.
local_reproduction: Copying an owned executable with copyfile fails to execute; copy2 preserves its mode and executes successfully. An initial attempt using /bin/echo hit macOS protected file flags during copystat, so the reproduction uses an ordinary owned executable like the CI binary.
